title: vernonia cinerea var. vialis
intro: Vernonia cinerea var. vialis, commonly known as 'Tulsi's Bane' or 'Chhoti Pili', is a plant species native to tropical regions of the world, specifically in the Indian subcontinent and Southeast Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which are attributed to its ability to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The health benefits associated with Vernonia cinerea var. vialis include its use in treating fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues, while its therapeutic actions include analgesic, anti-diarrheal, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
